options.description: The check is in place and shows 'could not check' until you push plumb's main. Nothing gets pushed from here; pushing is your decision, and once done it works everywhere.
options.label: Land it; I push main later (Recommended)

options.description: Nothing lands until you push. No 'could not check' line meanwhile, but the red line stays missing in other repositories.

payload.question: The 'always use the repo version' check will read plumb's GitHub repository (Cols77/plumb) for the latest version, but that repository is empty: main has never been pushed. Until it is, every session will show a plain 'could not check', never a red mismatch. How should we proceed?
